notes: No synchronous service calls: no outbound HTTP, gRPC or DB call to another service in src/flagd-ui/src. The browser-side fetches go to the service's own routes (src/components/basic/BasicView.tsx:21, src/components/advanced/AdvancedView.tsx:23) and to external URLs https://flagd.dev/schema/v0/flags.json and targeting.json (src/components/advanced/AdvancedView.tsx:45-46), which are not services of this system. Reads and writes go to the local file data/ (src/app/api/read-file/route.ts:12, src/app/api/write-to-file/route.ts:10), which is the host directory ./src/flagd mounted at /app/data (docker-compose.yml:629); this is a shared file, not a call.
No messages published or consumed: no Kafka or other broker client in src/flagd-ui (package.json:11-17 lists none).

No registry, discovery or coordinator: no registration or heartbeat code in src/flagd-ui/src; no liveness mechanism configured in docker-compose.yml:605-629 or compose.candidate-postures.yml:139-144. The compose depends_on flagd is condition service_started (docker-compose.yml:626-627), not a registration.

No health check: the flagd-ui block docker-compose.yml:605-629 has no healthcheck key; src/flagd-ui/Dockerfile:1-33 has no HEALTHCHECK instruction; compose.candidate-postures.yml:139-144 sets none. Health-check absence is library default, not in these files, for the probe itself.

Replicas: no deploy.replicas or scale key in docker-compose.yml:611-614 (deploy block sets only memory limit 150M, line 614) or in compose.candidate-postures.yml:139-144; Compose default 1 (library default, not in these files).

Telemetry interval not stated: no export interval or batch setting for flagd-ui in docker-compose.yml:616-622, .env, or src/otelcollector/otelcol-config.yml; library default, not in these files. Telemetry is sent over OTLP/HTTP to otelcol port 4318 (docker-compose.yml:617, .env:27 and .env:29). The SDK that reads OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is @vercel/otel (package.json:12); that it reads this variable is library behaviour, not in these files.

Posture override: compose.candidate-postures.yml:139-144 sets OTEL_SDK_DISABLED, OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER, OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER and OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER for flagd-ui from OTEL_CANDIDATE_FLAGD_UI_* variables, so the emitted telemetry is posture-dependent. The values are not set in these files. The span sensor below is the registration in src/flagd-ui/src/instrumentation.ts:5-6; whether @vercel/otel emits request spans from it is library behaviour, not in these files. No metric or log sensor is registered in these files.

replicas.note: library default, not in these files: no replicas key in the flagd-ui block docker-compose.yml:605-629 (its deploy block at lines 611-614 sets only a memory limit) nor in compose.candidate-postures.yml:139-144

exportsTelemetryTo.note: Compose resolves the host from .env:27; the endpoint is docker-compose.yml:617 (http://${OTEL_COLLECTOR_HOST}:${OTEL_COLLECTOR_PORT_HTTP}), port 4318 from .env:29 OTEL_COLLECTOR_PORT_HTTP=4318 (OTLP/HTTP)
